Vacancy for Emergency Medicine Medical Officer
Friday, 16 December 2022
2987 Hits
Medical Superintendent, Kasturba Hospital invites applications on plain paper for the following post along with attested copies of certificates and testimonials of educational qualification and experience certificates. The applications must reach the Medical Superintendent, Kasturba Hospital, Sewagram, Dist. Wardha  442102 on or before
30/12/2022
Emergency Medicine Medical Officer (3 Posts )
M.B.B.S. with one year internship from a Recognized University.  Postgraduate/Degree candidates shall be preferred.
Duty hours      –          Eight hour duty
Salary              –          As per rule
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
